title: Pre-registered broad-PIT monthly fundamental quality family
audit_amendment: After the first execution, an audit found that the engine computed but did not inspect post-2022 return paths before applying the development gate. That run is invalid and preserved under the INVALID_PREMATURE_VALIDATION prefix. The script was changed only to stop simulation at 2022 unless a development row passes; hypotheses, scores, thresholds, costs, and gates are unchanged.
objective: Test whether latest PIT quarterly profitability and balance-sheet quality contain a large enough monthly cross-sectional stock edge after costs.
search_plan: Profitability: operating margin, gross margin, ROA, and operating cash flow/assets.
Balance-sheet quality: current ratio, inverse liabilities/assets, and cash-minus-accounting-income accrual quality.
Composite quality: combine the two independent fundamental blocks.
Market-neutral composite: long the strongest and short the weakest composite names to separate stock alpha from market beta.

data_contract.touched_validation: 2023-01-03 through 2024-12-31; opened only after a development pass
data_contract.universe: Quarterly PIT market-cap top500 intersected with the daily PIT eligible universe, ADV20 >= $10m, and an exact 09:35 price.
data_contract.financial_clock: Use only Polygon quarterly statements with filing_date strictly before the rebalance date; latest known filing per CIK; maximum age 200 calendar days.
data_contract.fundamental_limits: No annual or TTM values are synthesized because the local cache contains quarterly rows and almost no explicit Q4 rows.
data_contract.rebalance: First available trading session of each month at 09:35; hold to the next monthly 09:35 rebalance.
data_contract.selection: Cross-sectional 2.5/97.5 winsorization, SIC z-score when at least five observations otherwise global z-score, equal weight, 30 names per leg, maximum three names per SIC description.
data_contract.gross: 0.95x for long-only; 0.475x long plus 0.475x short for market-neutral.
data_contract.costs: 4 bps per traded dollar base, 8 bps stress, 1% annual short borrow.
data_contract.missing_prices: Existing positions carry the last mark when an exact 09:35 price is absent; no new trade is allowed without an exact price; missing marks are reported.

shared_development_gate.winner: Highest development Sharpe, then CAGR, among passing rows only.

validation_gate: Selected development winner must have positive PnL, positive active CAGR, DD no worse than -25%, positive 8 bps stress PnL, and positive PnL in both 2023 and 2024.

audit_controls.rule_selection_effect: At most one development winner; validation cannot replace it.
audit_controls.trade_selection_effect: Membership, latest filing, eligibility, exact price, sector cap, turnover, costs, and compounding are rebuilt at each rebalance.
